needsFromHuman: A Revinate customer or partner account. Nothing here can be bought or signed up for online.
Reputation module: a Porter API key and API secret from Revinate, and the username of a Revinate user with access to the key and to a hotel with reviews
Guest Data module: a CDP API Client ID and Client Secret from Revinate, and an Account ID they are authorized for, holding guest profiles and reservations
For the trigger flows: somebody who can answer a guest survey and change a reservation in the connected PMS while the flow waits
notes: Two modules with their own auth.js because the two APIs use different credentials and a hotel may have only one of them.
Both APIs are read-only: no Create, Update or Delete components.
CDP uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials. It is implemented as an apiKey-type connection (three fields); the components request the access token and cache it for its lifetime.
Not built: Find Widget Reviews, Find Hotel Sets, Find Hotel Set Reviews (lower priority in the issue; reachable through Make API Call).
verify.json has no round-trip spec: there is nothing to write.
Find Reviews asks for 100 reviews, not the API maximum of 1000: a review can carry a whole survey and 1000 of them could exceed the engine's message size.
